title: Correct development-governance drift and ship missing protocols

requirement.summary: Keep AgentGov centered on governing coding agents during development and make the first missing portable protocols available to adopting repositories.

objective.rationale: The user explicitly rejected PR-time governance as the product center and approved the solution that governs requirement, architecture, action loops, and completion during coding.

goal: Correct NYC pilot and roadmap drift, add portable requirement-admission, stagnation, and invariant-reconciliation Skills, and declare the provisional development-time governance capability.
non_goals: Do not modify the NYC Taxi or AI Radar repositories or import their runtime code, data, business rules, credentials, or project-specific policy.
Do not implement MCP, IDE hooks, mechanical runtime interruption, event-schema changes, or a persisted Registry.
Do not migrate GitHub workflows, create a release candidate, commit, push, merge, release, or deploy.
acceptance_signals: Requirement admission, action-loop stagnation, and invariant reconciliation are portable routed Skills installed into newly initialized repositories.
Tests preserve the boundary that semantic judgments are advisory and only humans admit tasks or approve durable governance changes.
README, STATUS, extraction map, and development plan agree that development-time governance is core, NYC is the first shadow development-loop pilot, and PR/CI is a later independent backstop.
The repository Inventory honestly declares development-time coding-agent governance as provisional rather than implying runtime enforcement or complete coverage.
Focused tests, the full unit suite, repository self-check, task checks, and diff checks pass.
validation_commands: python -m unittest tests.test_agent_skills tests.test_initializer tests.test_user_documentation tests.test_adoption_path -v

items: A protocol could accidentally present semantic judgment as a deterministic failure.
A documentation correction could erase the useful historical CI pilot rather than distinguish it from the next development-loop pilot.
Adding repository-native Skills without initializer and packaging updates would create a false adoption claim.

stop_conditions: Stop if the change requires copying AI Radar or NYC implementation or project-specific policy.
Stop if advisory protocols require a claim of mechanical runtime enforcement.
Stop if the requested solution expands into GitHub migration, event schema, release, or external repository writes.

decision.rationale: After reviewing the development-loop solution, the user explicitly said to proceed. The bounded implementation is delivered as uncommitted review material and is paused for routing hygiene; this does not claim acceptance, commit, merge, release, or external pilot completion.
